mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates an accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% (based on 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: An annualized inflation rate above 3.5% (CPIAUCSL) signals imminent monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5% (based on 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) and strong job growth (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly) indicates a tight labor market supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% (based on 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion (HOUST > 1000 and GDPC1 annualized growth > 2.0%), high housing starts signal overbuilding and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1000 and GDPC1 annualized growth > 2.0% (based on 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained employment level above 140,000 thousand (PAYEMS) indicates robust labor market conditions supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS exceeds 140,000 (based on 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 (INDPRO) signals weakening economic activity, increasing recession risk and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO falls below 100 (based on 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high consumer spending (RSAFS > 450,000) and elevated housing starts (HOUST > 1000) indicate excessive aggregate demand, triggering inflationary pressures and monetary tightening, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS > 450,000 and HOUST > 1000 (based on 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-constrained environment (INDPRO < 100 and GDPC1 annualized growth < 1.0%), a decline in industrial production signals deepening recession risk, reducing corporate earnings and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100 and GDPC1 annualized growth < 1.0% (based on 3-year rolling window).
